# sh_vars (Data Source)

The `sh_vars` data source takes a list of environment variable names and returns them as key-value pairs.

## Example Usage

```terraform
provider "sh" {}

data "sh_vars" "example" {
  names = [
    "HOME",
    "HOSTNAME",
    "AWS_PROFILE"
  ]
}

output "values" {
  value = data.sh_vars.example.values
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `names` (List of String) Names of the environment variables to extract.

### Optional

- `required` (Boolean) Requires all variables listed to be present and extracted successfully.

### Read-Only

- `values` (Map of String) Map of variables extracted from the environment.
